title: Navalia: Advancing Cowork Agents through Verifiable Task Synthesis and Long-Horizon Post-Training
abstract: arXiv:2610.26887v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents are evolving from conversational assistants into Cowork Agents capable of autonomous planning, tool use, and complex task execution. Financial analysis requires these agents to integrate cross-document evidence and perform multistep numerical reasoning, but expert task authoring is costly, while direct LLM synthesis struggles to produce challenging tasks with reliable answers. We introduce Navalia, a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports as its data source, Navalia semantically selects supporting evidence from complete fact sets and constructs executable computation chains to generate analytical tasks with traceable evidence and actual data dependencies between steps. translated_title: Navalia：通过可验证任务合成与长程后训练推进协作智能体
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体正在从对话助手演变为具备自主规划、工具使用和复杂任务执行能力的协作智能体。金融分析要求这类智能体整合跨文档证据并进行多步数值推理，但专家编写任务成本高昂，而直接由LLM合成的任务又难以在具有挑战性的同时保证答案可靠。我们提出Navalia，一个将可验证任务合成与长程后训练相结合的协作智能体框架。Navalia以公司财务报告为数据源，从完整的事实集合中语义化地选取支持性证据，并构建可执行的计算链，从而生成具有可追溯证据以及步骤间真实数据依赖关系的分析任务。我们进一步采用独立的LLM审查与程序化检查来验证证据一致性和答案正确性。经验证的任务将被……
tldr: Navalia框架以财务报告为数据源，通过可验证的任务合成自动生成具有可追溯证据和多步数据依赖的分析任务，并结合长程后训练来提升协作智能体的自主规划与复杂任务执行能力。
en_tdlr: Navalia is a framework that advances cowork agents by combining verifiable task synthesis—automatically generating financially grounded analytical tasks with traceable evidence and real inter-step data dependencies, verified through independent LLM review and programmatic checks—with long-horizon post-training.
